mainText: Fifa accuses Uefa of 'misinformation campaign'. Uefa's suggestions that Fifa president Gianni Infantino "violated any law or ethical principle are categorically without merit" says world football's governing body. Man City CEO defiant over Premier League charges. Manchester City chief executive Ferran Soriano issues a defiant message to the executives of other teams about the club being found guilty of a majority of Premier League charges, BBC Sport has been told. Republic of Ireland call up Hopcroft for play-off. Republic of Ireland boss Carla Ward includes Crystal Palace midfielder Shanade Hopcroft in her squad for next month's Women's World Cup play-off against Kazakhstan.

mainText: Watch: What we do and don't know about the RAF Fairford incident. BBC correspondent Daniel Sandford explains where the investigation goes from here. OpenAI scraps rollout of new model over safety concerns. The firm also issued an update on incidents in which its models accessed Australian government systems. Sir Ranulph Fiennes' relatives tell BBC it's 'very painful' not being able to visit him. It has been alleged that Sir Ranulph has been admitted to a number of care homes under assumed names. Watch: 'Ship buster' missiles sink old US warship in live fire training off Scotland. The 43-year-old decommissioned frigate was used for target practice off the Outer Hebrides.
